answer: The registry runs a ripple bounty audit: every identity posts a ferrous bond — the k-th from one funder posts k tokens at $20 each, held 13 epochs. Anyone may challenge one for $5; a jury re-verifies it, and a fake is left hollow — bond seized, record emptied — while the exposure ripples outward: the funder's other identities are audited that epoch. Funders are bonded identities with clean 13-epoch records, so splitting only moves the bill. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 1+2+…+1,000 ferrous tokens, $10,010,000, all forfeitable in one ripple; an honest applicant posts one token, $20.
